description: What is Odysseus AI? Odysseus AI is a private AI-powered research workspace designed for researchers, analysts, and knowledge workers who need accurate, source-traceable insights. It combines intelligent note-taking, source management, and AI-generated reports — all routed through OpenRouter for flexible model selection. Key Features - **Source-traceable reports** — Every AI-generated insight is linked back to its original source, ensuring full research transparency. - **Private research workspa
